literature.lead_zh: 本期基孔肯雅病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 与外泌体相关的四跨膜蛋白CD63、CD9和CD151支持CHIKV在滑膜成纤维细胞中的感染。沉默CD63和CD151会降低亚基因组复制子活性,而沉默所有三种四跨膜蛋白会减少病毒子代的产生。CD9定位于复制位点附近,其沉默会减少细胞内CHIKV的基因组积累。 [10.1016/j.celrep.2026.118058]
综述得出结论,体外关节模型提供了灵活且与人类相关的途径,以复制CHIKV诱导的关节炎的关键特征。这些模型有助于研究关节微环境中免疫细胞、基质细胞和细胞外基质(ECM)之间的相互作用,这对于理解CHIKV 发病机制至关重要。 [10.1038/s42003-026-10559-4]
在主要和次要结局指标中,治疗前后治疗的变化显示出显著改善,即。 [10.14719/pst.13827]

从Bilibili、Weibo和Zhihu(基于API)收集了涉及登革热、基孔肯雅热或其媒介的中文公共帖子、评论和弹幕,由于平台的反自动化控制,抖音和小红书的数据(n = 97)是手动提取的,并以描述性方式报告。自动化的KAP分类器显示弱到中等的可靠性(宏观κ = 0.24;预防措施κ = 0.09,置信区间包含零;疾病κ = 0.93)。错误信息很少(每1,000条记录3.47条);人传人谬误产生了零条声明,阴谋论来源的错误信息最多(27.8%),而在暴发期间纠正性内容上升,而错误信息没有增加。 [10.1186/s12889-026-29595-0]

key_findings_en: Minsap confirmed the circulation of chikungunya in Cuba and identified areas with higher incidence rates. Chikungunya cases are on the rise in Cuba, as reported by the Cuban Health Ministry. [news-232556ade1ac7dfd]

papers.title: Chikungunya virus uses the tetraspanins CD63, CD9, and CD151 to replicate in human synovial fibroblasts
papers.abstract: The arthritogenic alphavirus chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes debilitating long-lasting joint pain. Host factors used by CHIKV to infect joint cells are largely unknown. Here, we evaluated the role of the 19 tetraspanins expressed in primary human synovial fibroblasts in virus infection. The exosome-associated tetraspanins CD63, CD9, and CD151 supported CHIKV infection of joint fibroblasts. Silencing of CD63 and CD151 reduced subgenomic replicon activity. CD9 localized in close proximity to replication sites and its silencing reduced intracellular CHIKV genome accumulation. Silencing of all three tetraspanins reduced progeny virus production. While these tetraspanins were dispensable for CHIKV entry into joint fibroblasts, the receptor MXRA8 promoted cell entry. Our findings demonstrate that CHIKV exploits tetraspanins as host factors in synovial fibroblasts, shedding light on molecular mechanisms underlying CHIKV pathogenesis in joint tissues.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate host factors used by Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) to infect joint cells, as the mechanisms underlying CHIKV infection of synovial fibroblasts remain poorly understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated the role of tetraspanins in primary human synovial fibroblasts using CHIKV as the target virus. The research was conducted in 2026 and focused on the molecular interactions of CHIKV with these host factors.
analysis.methods: The researchers assessed the role of tetraspanins in CHIKV infection through silencing experiments and evaluated the effects on subgenomic replicon activity and progeny virus production.
analysis.main_results: The exosome-associated tetraspanins CD63, CD9, and CD151 supported CHIKV infection of synovial fibroblasts. Silencing of CD63 and CD151 reduced subgenomic replicon activity, while silencing of all three tetraspanins reduced progeny virus production. papers.title_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒利用四跨膜蛋白CD63、CD9和CD151在人类滑膜成纤维细胞中复制
papers.source_body_en: The arthritogenic alphavirus chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes debilitating long-lasting joint pain. Host factors used by CHIKV to infect joint cells are largely unknown. Here, we evaluated the role of the 19 tetraspanins expressed in primary human synovial fibroblasts in virus infection. The exosome-associated tetraspanins CD63, CD9, and CD151 supported CHIKV infection of joint fibroblasts. Silencing of CD63 and CD151 reduced subgenomic replicon activity. CD9 localized in close proximity to replication sites and its silencing reduced intracellular CHIKV genome accumulation. Silencing of all three tetraspanins reduced progeny virus production. While these tetraspanins were dispensable for CHIKV entry into joint fibroblasts, the receptor MXRA8 promoted cell entry. Our findings demonstrate that CHIKV exploits tetraspanins as host factors in synovial fibroblasts, shedding light on molecular mechanisms underlying CHIKV pathogenesis in joint tissues.
papers.abstract_zh: 致关节炎的α病毒基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)会引起 debilitating 长期的关节疼痛。CHIKV感染关节细胞所使用的宿主因子尚不清楚。在此研究中,我们评估了在原代人类滑膜成纤维细胞中表达的19种四跨膜蛋白在病毒感染中的作用。与外泌体相关的四跨膜蛋白CD63、CD9和CD151支持CHIKV对关节成纤维细胞的感染。沉默CD63和CD151会降低亚基因组复制子活性。CD9定位于复制位点附近,其沉默会减少细胞内CHIKV的基因组积累。沉默所有三种四跨膜蛋白会减少病毒子代的产生。尽管这些四跨膜蛋白对于CHIKV进入关节成纤维细胞并非必需,但受体MXRA8促进了细胞进入。我们的研究结果表明,CHIKV利用四跨膜蛋白作为宿主因子在滑膜成纤维细胞中进行复制,揭示了CHIKV在关节组织中发病机制的分子机制。

papers.title: Clinical and Genomic Characterization of Chikungunya Virus Variant reveals a Novel nsP3 H377P Substitution during the 2015 Outbreak in Central Valley of Chiapas, Mexico.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To characterize the clinical, diagnostic and genomic features of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection among patients presenting with an acute dengue-like illness in the inland Central Valley of Chiapas, Mexico, during the 2015 outbreak. METHODS: We retrospectively tested sera from 80 suspected cases using qRT-PCR, virus isolation, ELISA, indirect immunofluorescence, full-genome sequencing and phylogenetic analyses compared Central Valley isolates with contemporary CHIKV sequences from Mexico and the Americas. RESULTS: Sixty-seven patients (84%) were CHIKV-positive, including four CHIKV-DENV coinfections and serological evidence of prior DENV exposure in (60%) of cases. Fever and polyarthralgia occurred in all confirmed cases; headache, myalgia, conjunctivitis, rash, lymphadenopathy, and lymphopenia were also frequent. Two full genomes (PQ261036, PQ261037) clustered in the Asian/American lineage but formed a distinct subclade from coastal strains, one isolate carried a novel nsP3 H377P substitution in the hypervariable domain. CONCLUSIONS: CHIKV accounted for a substantial proportion of dengue-like illness during this inland outbreak, underscoring the limits of clinical diagnosis where CHIKV and DENV co-circulate. Genomic data revealed distinguishable Asian CHIKV variants and a previously unreported nsP3 substitution, supporting continued genomic surveillance of CHIKV in southern Mexico.
papers.journal: International journal of infectious diseases : IJID : official publication of the International Society for Infectious Diseases

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of differentiating chikungunya virus (CHIKV) from dengue virus (DENV) in clinical settings, as both cause similar symptoms and co-circulate in the region. The research sought to characterize the clinical, diagnostic, and genomic features of CHIKV infection during the 2015 outbreak in the Central Valley of Chiapas, Mexico.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a retrospective analysis of sera from 80 suspected cases of dengue-like illness collected during the 2015 outbreak in the Central Valley of Chiapas, Mexico. The population included patients presenting with acute symptoms consistent with chikungunya or dengue, with a focus on those in the inland region where the outbreak occurred.
analysis.methods: The researchers used qRT-PCR, virus isolation, ELISA, indirect immunofluorescence, and full-genome sequencing to test the sera. They also conducted phylogenetic analyses to compare the Central Valley isolates with contemporary CHIKV sequences from Mexico and the Americas.
analysis.main_results: Sixty-seven patients (84%) were confirmed to have CHIKV infection, with four cases showing coinfection with DENV. Serological evidence indicated prior DENV exposure in 60% of the cases. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the importance of genomic surveillance to track emerging variants of CHIKV, particularly in regions where it co-circulates with DENV. analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to characterize the clinical, diagnostic, and genomic features of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection during the 2015 outbreak in the Central Valley of Chiapas, Mexico, where it co-circulated with dengue virus (DENV). The researchers tested sera from 80 suspected cases using qRT-PCR, virus isolation, ELISA, indirect immunofluorescence, and full-genome sequencing. Sixty-seven patients (84%) were confirmed to have CHIKV infection, with four cases showing coinfection with DENV. All confirmed cases exhibited fever and polyarthralgia, while other symptoms were also frequent. Two full genomes clustered in the Asian/American lineage but formed a distinct subclade from coastal strains, and one isolate carried a novel nsP3 H377P substitution in the hypervariable domain. The study highlights the need for genomic surveillance to monitor emerging CHIKV variants and improve diagnostic accuracy in regions where CHIKV and DENV co-circulate. The evidence is moderate due to the retrospective nature of the study and potential cross-reactivity in serological tests.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决在临床环境中区分基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)与登革病毒(DENV)的挑战,因为两者引起相似症状且在该地区共循环。研究旨在描述2015年墨西哥恰帕斯州中央谷地暴发期间CHIKV感染的临床、诊断和基因组特征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对2015年墨西哥恰帕斯州中央谷地收集的80例疑似登革热样疾病的血清样本进行回顾性分析。研究人群包括出现急性症状与基孔肯雅热或登革热相符的患者,特别关注内陆地区暴发发生地的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用qRT-PCR、病毒分离、ELISA、间接免疫荧光和全基因组基因组测序对血清样本进行了检测。他们还进行了系统发育分析,将中央谷地的分离株与墨西哥及美洲的当代CHIKV序列进行比较。
elements_zh.main_results: 67例患者(84%)被确认感染CHIKV,其中4例为CHIKV与DENV的混合感染。血清学证据表明,60%的病例存在先前DENV暴露。所有确诊的CHIKV病例均出现发热和关节痛,而其他症状如头痛、肌肉痛、结膜炎、皮疹、淋巴结肿大和淋巴细胞减少也频繁出现。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究发现两个完整的基因组在亚洲/美洲谱系中聚类,但与沿海株形成不同的亚群。其中一株分离株携带了在高变区发现的新nsP3 H377P突变,突显了此次暴发期间CHIKV中此前未报告的遗传变化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了持续进行CHIKV基因组监测的重要性,特别是在其与DENV共循环的地区。这有助于提高诊断准确性,并理解CHIKV的传播机制。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于对血清样本的回顾性检测,可能引入回忆偏倚。证据强度中等,因为结果由基因组和血清学数据支持,但受限于研究设计和血清学检测中可能的交叉反应。

papers.abstract_zh: OBJECTIVES: 为了在2015年墨西哥恰帕斯州内陆中央谷地出现急性登革热样症状的患者中,描述基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)感染的临床、诊断和基因组特征。METHODS: 我们回顾性地对80例疑似病例的血清样本进行了qRT-PCR、病毒分离、ELISA、间接免疫荧光、全基因组基因组测序,并通过系统发育分析将中央谷地的分离株与墨西哥及美洲的当代CHIKV序列进行比较。RESULTS: 67例患者(84%)为CHIKV阳性,包括4例CHIKV与DENV的混合感染,以及60%的病例存在先前DENV暴露的血清学证据。所有确诊病例均出现发热和关节痛;头痛、肌肉痛、结膜炎、皮疹、淋巴结肿大和淋巴细胞减少也较为常见。两个完整的基因组(PQ261036,PQ261037)在亚洲/美洲谱系中聚类,但与沿海株形成不同的亚群,其中一株携带了在高变区发现的新nsP3 H377P突变。CONCLUSIONS: 在此次内陆暴发期间,CHIKV占登革热样疾病的相当大比例,突显了在CHIKV和DENV共循环地区临床诊断的局限性。基因组数据揭示了可区分的亚洲CHIKV变种以及此前未报告的nsP3突变,支持在墨西哥南部持续进行CHIKV的基因组监测。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决在临床环境中区分基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)与登革病毒(DENV)的挑战,因为两者引起相似症状且在该地区共循环。研究旨在描述2015年墨西哥恰帕斯州中央谷地暴发期间CHIKV感染的临床、诊断和基因组特征。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对2015年墨西哥恰帕斯州中央谷地收集的80例疑似登革热样疾病的血清样本进行回顾性分析。研究人群包括出现急性症状与基孔肯雅热或登革热相符的患者,特别关注内陆地区暴发发生地的患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员使用qRT-PCR、病毒分离、ELISA、间接免疫荧光和全基因组基因组测序对血清样本进行了检测。他们还进行了系统发育分析,将中央谷地的分离株与墨西哥及美洲的当代CHIKV序列进行比较。
analysis_zh.main_results: 67例患者(84%)被确认感染CHIKV,其中4例为CHIKV与DENV的混合感染。血清学证据表明,60%的病例存在先前DENV暴露。所有确诊的CHIKV病例均出现发热和关节痛,而其他症状如头痛、肌肉痛、结膜炎、皮疹、淋巴结肿大和淋巴细胞减少也频繁出现。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究发现两个完整的基因组在亚洲/美洲谱系中聚类,但与沿海株形成不同的亚群。其中一株分离株携带了在高变区发现的新nsP3 H377P突变,突显了此次暴发期间CHIKV中此前未报告的遗传变化。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了持续进行CHIKV基因组监测的重要性,特别是在其与DENV共循环的地区。这有助于提高诊断准确性,并理解CHIKV的传播机制。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于对血清样本的回顾性检测,可能引入回忆偏倚。证据强度中等,因为结果由基因组和血清学数据支持,但受限于研究设计和血清学检测中可能的交叉反应。

papers.title: Public discourse on knowledge, attitudes, and practices toward dengue and chikungunya in China: a multi-platform social media infoveillance study, 2022–2026
papers.abstract: Dengue and chikungunya are expanding mosquito-borne arboviral diseases. In 2025, Guangdong (Foshan), China, experienced the largest domestic chikungunya outbreak on record. Real-world Chinese public discourse remains poorly characterised, and domestic KAP survey evidence is sparse and localised. We used social-media infoveillance to characterise Chinese public discourse on dengue and chikungunya across five platforms (2022–2026). We conducted an observational, cross-sectional infoveillance study. Public Chinese-language posts, comments, and danmaku mentioning dengue, chikungunya, or their vector were collected from Bilibili, Weibo, and Zhihu (API-based) and, because of platform anti-automation controls, Douyin and Xiaohongshu (manually extracted; n = 97, reported descriptively). After deduplication and relevance filtering, 4,707 records (4,610 API-collected) formed the analytic sample. We applied rule-based disease classification, a lexicon-based multi-label KAP-aligned thematic classifier (six themes), SnowNLP sentiment, a regex-screen plus adjudicated misinformation workflow, and a stratified qualitative subsample of long-form posts (n = 53). Classifier reliability was quantified against blinded human coding (N = 250). Multi-platform incremental value was assessed by active-month coverage. Chikungunya-focused content (38.5%) exceeded dengue-focused (25.9%); discourse spiked in July–August 2025 (n = 1,166 and 987), coinciding with the Guangdong outbreak. Transmission-route (33.8%) and preventive-practice (17.8%) themes dominated, whereas vaccine/treatment knowledge was thinnest (7.5%). Sentiment (n = 3,571) was near-balanced negative 40.9% / positive 40.6% / neutral 18.4%; disease focus was a significant but weak predictor (χ2 = 24.2, p < 0.001, Cramér's V = 0.058). The automated KAP classifier showed weak-to-moderate reliability (macro κ = 0.24; preventive-practice κ = 0.09, CI including zero; disease κ = 0.93). Misinformation was rare (3.47 per 1,000 records); the person-to-person myth yielded zero assertions, conspiracy-origin had the highest yield (27.8%), and corrective content rose during the outbreak while misinformation did not. Daily social-media volume peaked on 28 July 2025, ~ 7–9 days after the official case peak (19 July 2025), providing no advance warning. Multi-platform coverage: the three API platforms' active-month union was 51 months, but Weibo alone would have missed 31. Chinese public discourse on dengue and chikungunya is strongly outbreak-driven, prevention-oriented, and shows an affective valence near-balanced between negative vigilance and positive reassurance. The 2025 Guangdong outbreak exposed persistent discourse gaps, especially around vaccine/treatment reality and disease differentiation, that warrant proactive, video-first, multi-platform health communication. Social-media infoveillance is a useful complementary outbreak-intelligence component, but in this outbreak it tracked rather than preceded the clinical peak; multi-platform design materially outperformed any single platform. What is already known about this subject • Dengue is a long-established mosquito-borne disease in southern China, but chikungunya had not caused a substantial domestic outbreak on the mainland until the 2025 Guangdong/Foshan event, the largest chikungunya outbreak ever recorded in mainland China. • Surveys show that public knowledge of arboviral diseases is uneven, yet real-world public discourse on Chinese social media has not been systematically characterised for either dengue or chikungunya. • Social-media infoveillance is an established early-warning and health-communication tool, but most Chinese-platform studies focus on a single platform or a single disease. What this study adds • A five-platform (Bilibili, Weibo, Zhihu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu), 4,707-record infoveillance dataset spanning 2022–2026 shows that public attention shifted sharply toward chikungunya during the 2025 outbreak (38.5% of disease-focused posts vs 25.9% for dengue), with a clear monthly spike in July–August 2025 that mirrors the official Guangdong epidemic curve. • A KAP-framed discourse analysis shows that the vaccine/treatment theme is the thinnest discourse strand (7.6%). papers.title_zh: 中国公众对登革热和基孔肯雅热的知识、态度和行为的讨论:2022–2026年多平台社交媒体信息监测研究
papers.source_body_en: Dengue and chikungunya are expanding mosquito-borne arboviral diseases. In 2025, Guangdong (Foshan), China, experienced the largest domestic chikungunya outbreak on record. Real-world Chinese public discourse remains poorly characterised, and domestic KAP survey evidence is sparse and localised. We used social-media infoveillance to characterise Chinese public discourse on dengue and chikungunya across five platforms (2022–2026). We conducted an observational, cross-sectional infoveillance study. Public Chinese-language posts, comments, and danmaku mentioning dengue, chikungunya, or their vector were collected from Bilibili, Weibo, and Zhihu (API-based) and, because of platform anti-automation controls, Douyin and Xiaohongshu (manually extracted; n = 97, reported descriptively). After deduplication and relevance filtering, 4,707 records (4,610 API-collected) formed the analytic sample. We applied rule-based disease classification, a lexicon-based multi-label KAP-aligned thematic classifier (six themes), SnowNLP sentiment, a regex-screen plus adjudicated misinformation workflow, and a stratified qualitative subsample of long-form posts (n = 53). Classifier reliability was quantified against blinded human coding (N = 250). Multi-platform incremental value was assessed by active-month coverage. Chikungunya-focused content (38.5%) exceeded dengue-focused (25.9%); discourse spiked in July–August 2025 (n = 1,166 and 987), coinciding with the Guangdong outbreak. Transmission-route (33.8%) and preventive-practice (17.8%) themes dominated, whereas vaccine/treatment knowledge was thinnest (7.5%). Sentiment (n = 3,571) was near-balanced negative 40.9% / positive 40.6% / neutral 18.4%; disease focus was a significant but weak predictor (χ2 = 24.2, p < 0.001, Cramér's V = 0.058). The automated KAP classifier showed weak-to-moderate reliability (macro κ = 0.24; preventive-practice κ = 0.09, CI including zero; disease κ = 0.93). Misinformation was rare (3.47 per 1,000 records); the person-to-person myth yielded zero assertions, conspiracy-origin had the highest yield (27.8%), and corrective content rose during the outbreak while misinformation did not. Daily social-media volume peaked on 28 July 2025, ~ 7–9 days after the official case peak (19 July 2025), providing no advance warning. Multi-platform coverage: the three API platforms' active-month union was 51 months, but Weibo alone would have missed 31. Chinese public discourse on dengue and chikungunya is strongly outbreak-driven, prevention-oriented, and shows an affective valence near-balanced between negative vigilance and positive reassurance. The 2025 Guangdong outbreak exposed persistent discourse gaps, especially around vaccine/treatment reality and disease differentiation, that warrant proactive, video-first, multi-platform health communication. Social-media infoveillance is a useful complementary outbreak-intelligence component, but in this outbreak it tracked rather than preceded the clinical peak; multi-platform design materially outperformed any single platform. What is already known about this subject • Dengue is a long-established mosquito-borne disease in southern China, but chikungunya had not caused a substantial domestic outbreak on the mainland until the 2025 Guangdong/Foshan event, the largest chikungunya outbreak ever recorded in mainland China. • Surveys show that public knowledge of arboviral diseases is uneven, yet real-world public discourse on Chinese social media has not been systematically characterised for either dengue or chikungunya. • Social-media infoveillance is an established early-warning and health-communication tool, but most Chinese-platform studies focus on a single platform or a single disease. What this study adds • A five-platform (Bilibili, Weibo, Zhihu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu), 4,707-record infoveillance dataset spanning 2022–2026 shows that public attention shifted sharply toward chikungunya during the 2025 outbreak (38.5% of disease-focused posts vs 25.9% for dengue), with a clear monthly spike in July–August 2025 that mirrors the official Guangdong epidemic curve. • A KAP-framed discourse analysis shows that the vaccine/treatment theme is the thinnest discourse strand (7.6%). This fits the absence of a domestically available chikungunya vaccine and exposes a discourse gap (a potential communication blind spot) for risk communication. • Sentiment was near-balanced (negative 40.9% vs positive 40.6%), and short-video platforms (Bilibili science videos exceeding one million views) functioned as the dominant knowledge carrier, so outbreak communication should be video-first and proactively address the "no vaccine / symptomatic treatment only" message. • Multi-platform, real-world evidence: 4,707 cleaned Chinese social-media records (2022–2026) provide the first cross-platform characterisation of public discourse on knowledge, attitudes, and practices toward dengue and chikungunya in China. • Outbreak signal validity: The July–August 2025 chikungunya attention spike on social media tracks the official Guangdong/Foshan epidemic curve, supporting social media as a near-real-time outbreak-surveillance signal. • Identified discourse gap: Vaccine/treatment discourse was the weakest theme (7.6%), reflecting the lack of a domestic chikungunya vaccine and pointing to a clear health-communication target. • Platform role: Short-video content (e.g., Bilibili explainer videos with >1 million views) was the main knowledge channel, arguing for video-first, proactive public-health messaging during arboviral outbreaks. • Methodological transparency: The study openly reports platform anti-automation constraints (Douyin/Xiaohongshu collected via manual extraction as exploratory supplements) and follows ROSES + STROBE reporting.

papers.title: Mathematical modeling of chikungunya transmission dynamics and control using disease-driven machine learning
papers.abstract: Abstract The Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a significant vector-borne threat; however, few models successfully integrate rigorous theoretical guarantees with efficient, reliable predictive tools. This study aims to address this gap by introducing a nonlinear seven-compartment human-mosquito model. This model includes susceptible, exposed, infected, and recovered humans, as well as susceptible, exposed, and infected mosquitoes. It accounts for latency stages on both sides of the transmission cycle, an epidemiological aspect that is often overlooked in existing CHIKV models. The mathematical well-posedness of the model is established by demonstrating the positivity and boundedness of solutions and calculating the basic reproduction number, denoted as $$\mathcal {R}_0$$ . Furthermore, it is shown that the disease-free equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable for $$\mathcal {R}_0 < 1$$ and, importantly, globally asymptotically stable across the feasible region when $$\mathcal {R}_0 \le 1$$ . This finding represents a stronger result than the local stability outcomes observed in similar models. The main methodological contribution is the development of a disease-informed machine learning framework based on a random projection neural network (RPNN) as a computationally efficient alternative to conventional deep neural networks (DNNs) to solve the CHIKV system. This is compared against a DNN benchmarked head-to-head on different epidemiological scenarios, with the RPNN consistently achieving higher accuracy, stability, and computational cost, thus offering the ability to serve as a surrogate solver for epidemic models more generally. We also validate the framework using real chikungunya surveillance data from Colombia, demonstrating that the fitted model reproduces the observed trajectory of the outbreak. The parametric analysis shows that higher transmission rates accelerate the onset of the disease, lower recovery rates prolong and enhance the infections, and a higher mortality rate of mosquitoes is an effective lever for outbreak control. The RPNN-based prediction framework and real data validation provide a joint and computationally efficient tool for analysis and control of chikungunya outbreaks as a result of the theoretical guarantees.

The parametric analysis shows that higher transmission rates accelerate the onset of the disease, lower recovery rates prolong and enhance the infections, and a higher mortality rate of mosquitoes is an effective lever for outbreak control. The RPNN-based prediction framework and real data validation provide a joint and computationally efficient tool for analysis and control of chikungunya outbreaks as a result of the theoretical guarantees.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)是一种重要的传播威胁;然而,目前很少有模型能够成功地将严格的理论保证与高效、可靠的预测工具相结合。本研究旨在通过引入一个非线性的七类人-蚊模型来填补这一空白。该模型包括易感、暴露、感染和康复的人类,以及易感、暴露和感染的蚊子。它考虑了基孔肯雅病毒传播循环中双方的潜伏阶段,这是现有基孔肯雅病毒模型中常被忽视的流行病学方面。通过证明解的正性和有界性,并计算基本再生数 $$\mathcal {R}_0$$,建立了该模型的数学适定性。进一步证明了当 $$\mathcal {R}_0 < 1$$ 时,无病平衡点是局部渐近稳定的,而当 $$\mathcal {R}_0 \le 1$$ 时,该平衡点在整个可行区域内是全局渐近稳定的。这一发现比类似模型中观察到的局部稳定性结果更为强大。主要方法学贡献是开发了一个基于随机投影神经网络(RPNN)的疾病驱动机器学习框架,作为传统深度神经网络(DNN)的计算高效替代方案,用于求解基孔肯雅病毒系统。该框架与在不同流行病学场景中基准测试的DNN进行了比较,结果显示RPNN在准确性、稳定性及计算成本方面均表现更优,从而提供了作为一般流行病模型替代求解器的能力。我们还使用了来自哥伦比亚的真实基孔肯雅病毒数据来验证该框架,证明拟合模型能够再现基孔肯雅病毒传播的观察轨迹。参数分析表明,更高的传播率会加速疾病的发生,较低的康复率则会延长并增强感染,而蚊子更高的传播率是控制基孔肯雅病毒传播的有效杠杆。基于RPNN的预测框架和真实数据验证为分析和控制基孔肯雅病毒传播提供了一个联合且计算高效的工具,这是由于模型的理论保证。

papers.full_text: Abstract Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) joint inflammation remains poorly understood, despite its clinical burden. This review surveys in vitro joint models which were originally developed for arthritis research and examine how they can be repurposed to study CHIKV joint pathology. We outline key considerations, limitations, and recommendations for adapting these models for infection studies, including facilitating infection susceptibility across joint models, tuning matrix composition, addressing cellular incompleteness through modeling relevant immune cells, improving culture longevity and reproducibility. Together, these models offer versatile and human-relevant approaches to replicate key features of joint inflammation in advancing the understanding of CHIKV-induced joint pathology. Introduction Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an arthritogenic alphavirus transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, has re-emerged as a significant global health concern. Both conditions involve CD4+ T cell activation and elevated pro-inflammatory cytokines, and transcriptomic analyses in mouse models have revealed overlapping gene signatures related to T cell activation, antigen presentation, and innate and adaptive immune responses4,5,6,7. However, similarity in gene expression does not imply identical disease mechanisms. RA is driven by a breakdown in immune tolerance, leading to the production of autoantibodies such as anti-citrullinated protein antibodies (ACPAs) and rheumatoid factor (RF), and is sustained by chronic CD4+ T cell activation with extensive crosstalk involving macrophages, dendritic cells, B cells, and fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS)5. In contrast, CHIKV-induced joint inflammation is initiated by viral infection, involves CD4+ T cells and macrophage interactions but lacks consistent autoantibody involvement, and is shaped by a chemokine-dominant profile (including CXCL8, CXCL9, and CXCL10) associated with antiviral responses8,9,10,11. While recent studies of CHIKV have primarily focused on systemic immune responses and macrophage-T cell interactions, it is likely that crosstalk between the resident cell types within the joint microenvironment, such as FLS, chondrocytes, and resident synovial macrophages, also contribute to CHIKV pathogenesis. These differences show that CHIKV-induced joint inflammation is a distinct pathophysiological process, and its mechanisms cannot be directly equated with those of autoimmune arthritides (Fig. 1). Complex interactions between immune cells, stromal cells, and extracellular matrix (ECM) components in the joint microenvironment may drive CHIKV-induced pathology and its potential persistence. Sophisticated joint-focused experimental systems are therefore required for dissecting the underlying tissue-specific processes, such as those established in the field of RA and osteoarthritis (OA). While OA is a progressive age-related degenerative disorder, CHIKV-associated joint inflammation is typically self-limiting, but can become chronic in a subset of patients. Despite these differences, OA-based models can provide a relevant platform to investigate inflammation-driven matrix degradation and chondrocyte dysfunction. While several arthritogenic alphaviruses, including RRV, ONNV, and MAYV, can also cause joint inflammation and present with persistent arthralgia, the depth of clinical and mechanistic understanding varies across these infections12. CHIKV has been extensively characterized, with a rich body of clinical and emerging tissue-level evidence. However, long-term and mechanistic data for other alphaviruses remain limited. The extent to which underlying pathogenic mechanisms are shared across these viruses remains poorly defined and reflect differences in available evidence rather than true biological divergence. This review was conducted as a narrative synthesis of the literature, with a focus on studies relevant to chikungunya virus-associated joint pathology and emerging joint models. Relevant articles were identified through searches of databases including PubMed, Web of Science, and Google Scholar using combinations of keywords such as “chikungunya virus”, “cartilage”, “synovial macrophages”, “fibroblastic-like synoviocytes”, and “joint models”. Rather than applying strict inclusion or exclusion criteria, studies were selected based on their relevance to the central themes of this review, with an emphasis on recent advances and mechanistic insights in CHIKV-associated joint pathology and joint modeling approaches. CHIKV-induced joint pathology To understand CHIKV joint pathology, it is important to consider the joint microenvironment, which provides the structural and biological context within which viral replication and immune activation occur. Firstly, the articular cartilage is an avascular and alymphatic tissue that lines the ends of bones within a joint and is composed primarily of chondrocytes embedded within an abundant ECM, allowing smooth articulation and absorbing load13. The surrounding synovial membrane lines the inner surface of the joint capsule and contains two main synoviocyte populations: type A macrophage-like synoviocytes, which function as phagocytic cells that clear debris and immune complexes, and type B FLS, which synthesize hyaluronan and lubricin to maintain joint lubrication and homeostasis14. Both synoviocytes and articular chondrocytes are immunologically active, capable of sensing pathogen- or damage-associated molecular patterns through pattern recognition receptors and responding via production of pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines15. The synovial membrane also produces synovial fluid, which fills the joint cavity and facilitates lubrication and nutrient and oxygen delivery to the avascular cartilage while serving as a reservoir for soluble mediators16. This tightly integrated joint microenvironment is highly susceptible to inflammatory disruption. The immunopathology of CHIKV infection has been extensively attributed to systemic immune responses, with CD4+ T cells playing a central role in driving joint inflammation and tissue damage. In mouse models, early studies demonstrated that depletion of CD4+ T cells significantly reduced footpad swelling without affecting viral load, indicating an inflammatory rather than antiviral functionality during CHIKV infection6. Within the joint-footpad, activated CD64+MHCII+ macrophages have been identified and shown to engage in pathogenic interactions with CD4+ T cells, contributing to local immunopathology through the secretion of inflammatory mediators (Fig. 2A)8. Complementing these murine findings, recent human blood studies have demonstrated that CHIKV-specific CD4+ T cells persist long after acute infection, predominantly produce TNF-α, implicating them in the maintenance of post-viral inflammation17. Viral antigen was also detected in the synovial biopsies (specifically, in synovial macrophages) of a CHIKV patient 18 months after the initial clinic visit18. In addition, CHIKV was also detected in joint tissues of non-human primates for up to 3 months post infection, raising the possibility of viral persistence19. Several studies have examined the roles of resident cell populations in CHIKV-induced joint pathology. Type B FLS or synovial fibroblasts are one of the main components in the joint microenvironment. Primary human FLS were susceptible to CHIKV replication in vitro, producing high viral titers of 105–106 pfu/ml and displaying cytopathic effects within days of infection20. Upon CHIKV infection, FLS predominantly secreted RANKL, IL-6, IL-8, and MCP-1, which recruited monocytes and drove their differentiation toward osteoclast-like cells (Fig. 2B). Notably, FLS were not major sources of TNF-α, IL-1β, or MMP-1, -2, or -13, which are known to induce arthritis. Instead, the resulting osteoclast-like cells contributed to bone resorption and secreted inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-α and IL-6, which exacerbated joint inflammation in vitro. This indicates that FLS are not direct mediators of joint destruction but instead act as initiators of an erosive cascade towards osteoclastogenesis. Single-cell transcriptomics have further implicated FLS as central effectors of CHIKV arthritis, highlighting their role in immune cell recruitment and RANKL-driven osteoclastogenesis21. Concordantly, proteomic profiling has demonstrated that CHIKV infection rapidly remodels the FLS proteome within 12 and 24 h post-infection, altering cellular trafficking and cytoskeletal, metabolic, and immune pathways in ways that may facilitate both viral replication and pro-inflammatory programming22. Finally, primary human FLS exhibited a miRNA-mediated dampening of innate signaling during CHIKV infection, with microarray profiling identifying approximately 26 host miRNAs predicted to target AKT3, TRIM26, SOCS7, and PELI1, consistent with suppression of the JAK-STAT, TLR, TNF, and NF-κB pathways that could favor viral persistence. Functionally, CHIKV upregulates miR-146a in human FLS, which downregulates TRAF6 and IRAK1/2, blunting NF-κB and thereby enhancing replication while modulating fibroblast inflammatory output23. Collectively, these findings identify FLS as pivotal amplifiers linking stromal infection to immune recruitment and joint damage. The role of type A macrophage-like synoviocytes (also called resident synovial macrophages) in CHIKV infection is less clear. Unlike the infiltrating monocyte-derived macrophages that dominate inflammatory settings, type A macrophages originate from embryonic precursors such as the yolk sac or fetal liver, and they are self-renewing and M2-like24. These macrophages were characterized as a unique CX3CR1+ tissue-resident population and known to establish a protective barrier at the synovial interface, where they limit immune cell entry via tight junctions, actively resolve inflammation through neutrophil clearance, and sustain homeostatic balance within the synovial microenvironment25,26. Their position at the synovial interface places these resident/barrier macrophages at a critical juncture between stromal integrity and viral pathogenesis, but whether they function as antigen-presenting sentinels or serve as potential reservoirs of persistence in the context of CHIKV infection is not yet known. Their roles remain largely unexplored due to the difficulty of isolating resident synovial macrophages, and most studies to date have relied on monocytic models such as THP-1 or U937 cell lines27,28,29. Very recently, chondrocytes were found to be permissive targets of CHIKV, whereby supporting viral replication and producing infectious virus30. Using a NanoLuc-expressing CHIKV, robust viral replication within the articular cartilage of immunocompetent mice was observed, with signals localizing to chondrocyte-rich regions. Histopathology confirmed infected chondrocytes with focal cartilage erosion and periarticular inflammation in mice. In vitro primary human chondrocytes were also productively infected, released infectious progeny, and underwent apoptosis. Infection also induced expression of MMP-3 and MMP-9, enzymes linked to proteoglycan and gelatin degradation, thereby coupling viral cytopathology with catabolic matrix remodeling (Fig. 2C). A CHIKV-infected 3D chondrocyte model cultured from patient joint samples also showed productive viral replication. Quantitative proteomics revealed strong interferon antiviral responses and broad remodeling of ubiquitination, phosphorylation, and metabolism, changes that were not found in matched 2D monolayers31. Taken together, these data established human chondrocytes as active participants in antiviral signaling and demonstrated that matrix context shapes virus-host interactions. Although evidence for CHIKV infection of chondrocytes is still emerging, it is supported by broader observations of joint tissue tropism across other arthritogenic alphaviruses, including Ross River Virus (RRV) and Mayaro virus (MAYV)32,33. Meanwhile, osteoblasts have also been identified as stromal targets of CHIKV infection. Infection of primary human osteoblasts supports viral replication and elicits robust secretion of IL-6 and RANKL, accompanied by reduced osteoprotegerin (OPG), thereby shifting the RANKL/OPG axis toward osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption (Fig. 2-D)34. The same cytokine imbalance was observed in the plasma of infected individuals, suggesting that the source of these mediators is osteoblasts35. While definitive in vivo validation is still lacking for CHIKV, comparable work in RRV has shown infected osteoblasts to display the same IL-6 and RANKL/OPG profiles. In murine models, this translates to bone loss measurable by micro-CT, with IL-6 neutralization attenuating osteoclast recruitment and preserving bone volume36. Importantly, this osteoblast program overlaps with observations from RA, where dysregulated RANKL/OPG signaling also fuels osteoclastogenesis and subchondral erosion37,38. Thus, in alphavirus arthritis, osteoblast infection adds a bone remodeling axis that complements synoviocyte-driven immune recruitment and chondrocyte-mediated matrix degradation. CHIKV-associated joint pathology is likely driven by multiple, non-mutually exclusive mechanisms. Among these, contributions from adaptive immune responses are relatively well supported. In contrast, several additional mechanisms have been proposed but remain poorly defined, including sustained activation and reprogramming of joint-resident stromal cells, persistence of replicating virus in tissue reservoirs, and retention of viral antigens in the absence of active replication. In this review, we adopt a framework in which persistent inflammation is primarily sustained by stromal–immune interactions following the acute phase, with viral or antigen persistence acting as potential initiating or amplifying factors. While evidence for long-term productive viral replication in joint tissues remains unclear, the presence of viral RNA or antigen and its role in local immune activation remains an area of ongoing investigation. Together, these findings suggest that CHIKV-associated joint inflammation is not solely immune-driven but is also shaped by dynamic interactions between immune and stromal compartments. Elucidating how viral infection influences stromal cell behavior and how these interactions sustain inflammation will be critical for understanding disease progression. Leveraging in vitro joint models developed in the arthritis field, therefore, provides a powerful approach to dissect these processes and to investigate how early viral events transition into a self-sustaining, tissue-specific inflammatory response. analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) joint inflammation, specifically examining arthritis models originally developed for arthritis research and how they can be repurposed to study CHIKV-induced joint pathology. The central question is how these models can be adapted to better understand the mechanisms of CHIKV joint inflammation, particularly its distinct pathophysiology compared to autoimmune conditions.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative analysis of in vitro joint models, with no explicit mention of systematic search methods, databases, or meta-analysis. It outlines key considerations for adapting these models, including infection susceptibility, matrix composition, immune cell modeling, and culture longevity and reproducibility.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that in vitro joint models provide versatile and human-relevant approaches to replicate key features of CHIKV-induced joint inflammation. These models are useful for studying the interactions between immune cells, stromal cells, and the extracellular matrix (ECM) in the joint microenvironment, which are critical for understanding CHIKV pathogenesis.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that while CHIKV-induced joint inflammation shares some immunological features with rheumatoid arthritis (RA), such as CD4+ T cell activation and pro-inflammatory cytokines, the mechanisms driving persistence remain poorly defined. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on developing more sophisticated in vitro joint models that incorporate relevant immune cells and ECM components to better replicate the joint-specific pathology of CHIKV. It also emphasizes the need for studies that explore the role of crosstalk between joint-resident cells in CHIKV pathogenesis.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores arthritis models originally developed for arthritis research and their potential to study Chikungunya virus (CHIKV)-induced joint inflammation. It highlights the clinical burden of CHIKV, particularly its persistent joint pain, which distinguishes it from other arboviruses and autoimmune conditions like rheumatoid arthritis (RA). The review outlines key considerations for adapting these models, including infection susceptibility, matrix composition, and immune cell interactions. While some immunological features overlap with RA, CHIKV-induced joint inflammation is driven by distinct mechanisms, such as chemokine profiles and antiviral responses. The review identifies gaps in understanding the joint-specific pathophysiology of CHIKV and suggests future research directions to improve in vitro models for studying this condition.

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议未来的研究应重点开发更复杂的体外关节模型,这些模型应包含相关免疫细胞和细胞外基质成分,以更准确地复制CHIKV的关节特异性病理。它还强调了需要研究关节驻留细胞之间相互作用在CHIKV 发病机制中的作用。

The central question is how these models can be adapted to better understand the mechanisms of CHIKV joint inflammation, particularly its distinct pathophysiology compared to autoimmune conditions.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative analysis of in vitro joint models, with no explicit mention of systematic search methods, databases, or meta-analysis. It outlines key considerations for adapting these models, including infection susceptibility, matrix composition, immune cell modeling, and culture longevity and reproducibility.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that in vitro joint models provide versatile and human-relevant approaches to replicate key features of CHIKV-induced joint inflammation. These models are useful for studying the interactions between immune cells, stromal cells, and the extracellular matrix (ECM) in the joint microenvironment, which are critical for understanding CHIKV pathogenesis.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that while CHIKV-induced joint inflammation shares some immunological features with rheumatoid arthritis (RA), such as CD4+ T cell activation and pro-inflammatory cytokines, the mechanisms driving persistence remain poorly defined. Additionally, the joint microenvironment's complex interactions are underexplored in CHIKV research, and there is a lack of comprehensive studies on the role of resident cell types like fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS) and synovial macrophages.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on developing more sophisticated in vitro joint models that incorporate relevant immune cells and ECM components to better replicate the joint-specific pathology of CHIKV. It also emphasizes the need for studies that explore the role of crosstalk between joint-resident cells in CHIKV pathogenesis.

papers.title_zh: 用于研究基孔肯雅病毒关节炎的关节模型
papers.source_body_en: This review surveys in vitro joint models which were originally developed for arthritis research and examine how they can be repurposed to study CHIKV joint pathology. As such, while in vitro joint models are broadly applicable across arthritogenic alphaviruses, this review focuses on CHIKV as a representative system with a more established evidence base. This review explores the ways in which experimental models originally developed for arthritis research can also be used to advance our understanding of CHIKV-induced joint pathology, drawing on tools such as two- and three-dimensional (2D and 3D) cell cultures, co-culture systems, and microfluidic joint-on-chip (JoC) platforms to interrogate viral-host interactions in a controlled, human-relevant context. This review was conducted as a narrative synthesis of the literature, with a focus on studies relevant to chikungunya virus-associated joint pathology and emerging joint models. Rather than applying strict inclusion or exclusion criteria, studies were selected based on their relevance to the central themes of this review, with an emphasis on recent advances and mechanistic insights in CHIKV-associated joint pathology and joint modeling approaches. Abstract Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) joint inflammation remains poorly understood, despite its clinical burden. We outline key considerations, limitations, and recommendations for adapting these models for infection studies, including facilitating infection susceptibility across joint models, tuning matrix composition, addressing cellular incompleteness through modeling relevant immune cells, improving culture longevity and reproducibility. papers.abstract_zh: 本综述调查了最初为关节炎研究开发的体外关节模型,并探讨了它们如何被重新利用来研究CHIKV引起的关节病理。因此,尽管体外关节模型在关节炎相关阿尔法病毒中具有广泛的应用性,但本综述重点聚焦于CHIKV作为具有更明确证据基础的代表性系统。本综述探讨了最初为关节炎研究开发的实验模型如何也能用于增进我们对CHIKV引起的关节病理的理解,利用诸如二维和三维(2D和3D)细胞培养、共培养系统以及微流控关节芯片(JoC)平台等工具,在可控且与人类相关的环境中研究病毒-宿主相互作用。本综述采用叙述性文献综合分析的方法,重点关注与基孔肯雅病毒相关关节病理以及新兴关节模型的研究。与应用严格的纳入或排除标准不同,研究的选择基于其与本综述核心主题的相关性,特别强调近期在CHIKV相关关节病理和关节建模方法上的进展和机制见解。尽管CHIKV引起的关节炎具有显著的临床负担,但其发病机制仍不明确。我们概述了在将这些模型用于感染研究时的关键考虑因素、局限性及建议,包括促进关节模型的感染易感性、调整基质组成、通过建模相关免疫细胞解决细胞不完整性问题,以及提高培养的持续时间和可重复性。总体而言,这些模型提供了灵活且与人类相关的途径,以复制CHIKV诱导关节炎的关键特征,从而推进对相关机制的理解。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)引起的关节炎,具体探讨了最初为关节炎研究开发的模型以及它们如何被重新利用来研究CHIKV诱导的关节病理。核心问题是这些模型如何被调整以更好地理解CHIKV关节炎的机制,特别是其与自身免疫性疾病相比独特的病理生理学特征。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对体外关节模型的叙述性分析,没有明确提及系统搜索方法、数据库或元分析。它概述了将这些模型进行调整的关键考虑因素,包括感染易感性、基质组成、免疫细胞建模以及培养的持续时间和可重复性。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,体外关节模型提供了灵活且与人类相关的途径,以复制CHIKV诱导的关节炎的关键特征。这些模型有助于研究关节微环境中免疫细胞、基质细胞和细胞外基质(ECM)之间的相互作用,这对于理解CHIKV 发病机制至关重要。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,尽管CHIKV引起的关节炎在某些免疫学特征上与类风湿性关节炎(RA)相似,例如CD4+ T细胞激活和促炎细胞因子,但驱动其持续性的机制仍不明确。此外,CHIKV研究中对关节微环境复杂相互作用的探索仍不足,缺乏对诸如成纤维细胞样滑膜细胞(FLS)和滑膜巨噬细胞等驻留细胞类型作用的全面研究。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议未来的研究应重点开发更复杂的体外关节模型,这些模型应包含相关免疫细胞和细胞外基质成分,以更准确地复制CHIKV的关节特异性病理。它还强调了需要研究关节驻留细胞之间相互作用在CHIKV 发病机制中的作用。

papers.title: Global patterns of genetic diversity and evolution in chikungunya virus E2 glycoprotein
papers.abstract: The E2 glycoprotein of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) mediates host-cell attachment and entry and contains key antigenic determinants targeted by host immune responses. Variation in E2 can influence host interaction, immune recognition, lineage diversification, and epidemic fitness, it represents a biologically relevant target for assessing evolutionary pressures and epidemic dynamics. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of E2 genetic diversity using a dataset of sequences collected across regions, hosts, and epidemic periods. Diversity indices, neutrality tests, and haplotypes network analysis were applied to characterize evolutionary pressures acting on E2 glycoprotein. To assess the influence of geography, host, and time on viral population structure, we performed spatial–temporal stratification and analysis to assess clustering patterns across lineages and regions using Fixation index test (Fst). Nucleotide diversity varied considerably across time, with the pre-expansion period (pre-2004) showing the highest diversity (Pi = 0.085), while more recent outbreak periods exhibited comparatively reduced diversity (Pi = 0.012). Neutrality tests revealed signatures of both purifying and positive selection across the three CKIKV E2 lineages (negatively statistically significant Tajima D, Fu and Li’s D, and Fu and Li’s F tests, p -values < 0.05) supported by codon‐based analyses showing pervasive purifying constraint across the E2 gene but recurrent diversifying signals at lineage‐specific sites, notably codon 146 in the West African lineage, codons 220, 245, 247, and 254 in the Asian lineage, and codons 54, 56, 102, 145, 163, 177, and 350 in the East/Central/South/African lineage. Population structure analyses using Fst indicated significant genetic differentiation between regional populations, reflecting restricted gene flow and localized evolutionary trajectories. Haplotype network analysis highlighted distinct clustering patterns shaped by geography and epidemic waves, reflecting the persistence of lineage-specific signatures across regions. At the same time, reduced connectivity among recent outbreak strains point to more discrete intercontinental movement events, likely driven by human-mediated vector dispersal or travel-associated introductions. Collectively, these findings underscore the spatiotemporal evolution of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein and its implications for viral adaptation and immune evasion.

Diversity indices, neutrality tests, and haplotypes network analysis were applied to characterize evolutionary pressures acting on E2 glycoprotein. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on sequence data and analytical methods.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)E2糖蛋白的遗传多样性和进化,重点关注其在宿主细胞附着、免疫识别和谱系多样化中的作用。E2糖蛋白是一个关键的抗原决定簇,代表了理解进化压力和流行病动态的生物学相关靶点。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用来自不同地区、宿主和流行病时期的序列数据集,对E2的遗传多样性进行了全面分析。利用Fst进行的种群结构分析表明,不同地区的种群之间存在显著的遗传分化,反映了基因流动受限和局部化的进化轨迹。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员应用了多样性指数、中性检验和单倍型网络分析来表征作用于E2糖蛋白的进化压力。为了评估地理、宿主和时间对病毒种群结构的影响,他们进行了时空分层分析,利用固定指数检验(Fst)来评估谱系和地区的聚类模式。
elements_zh.main_results: 核苷酸多样性在时间上变化显著,其中扩张前时期(2004年前)显示出最高的多样性(Pi = 0.085),而近期的暴发时期则表现出相对较低的多样性(Pi = 0.012)。中性检验显示,在三个CHIKV E2谱系中均存在正选择和纯化选择的信号,这得到了基于密码子的分析的支持,显示E2基因整体受到广泛的纯化约束,但在谱系特异性位点则出现了反复的多样化信号。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突出了CHIKV E2糖蛋白的时空进化特征,强调了其在病毒适应性和免疫逃逸中的作用。这些结果为塑造CHIKV多样性和谱系特异性变化的进化压力提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究的结果可以通过识别谱系特异性进化模式及其对免疫识别和流行病动态的影响,为CHIKV的监测策略提供信息。这种理解可能有助于开发更有效的诊断工具和干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的证据基于序列数据和分析方法,可能受到抽样和地理代表性相关的偏倚影响。由于结果来源于全面但可能有限的数据集,因此对研究发现的信心是中等的。

papers.title: Chikungunya and Coronavirus NL63: An Unheard of Coinfection
papers.abstract: Multiple viral infections are prevalent during monsoon season in Bangladesh. Therefore, coinfection is not uncommon. Here we report a 37-year-old male patient suffering from fever, joint pain, rash, loose motion, cough and runny nose. His investigations showed leucopenia with raised ESR and CRP. Chest imaging revealed a tiny nodule in the lower lobe of the left lung. Reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) revealed viral ribonucleic acid (RNA) of both chikungunya and coronavirus NL63. The patient was treated conservatively, and his condition improved. Bangladesh J Medicine 2026; 37(3): 262-265

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the occurrence of coinfections involving chikungunya virus during monsoon season in Bangladesh, as multiple viral infections are prevalent in this period.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This case report describes a 37-year-old male patient in Bangladesh who presented with fever, joint pain, rash, loose motion, cough, and runny nose, and was found to have a coinfection with chikungunya and coronavirus NL63.
analysis.methods: Reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) was used to detect viral ribonucleic acid (RNA) from the patient's specimens, confirming the presence of both chikungunya and coronavirus NL63.
analysis.main_results: The patient's investigations showed leucopenia with raised ESR and CRP, and chest imaging revealed a tiny nodule in the lower lobe of the left lung.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight a rare case of coinfection with chikungunya virus and coronavirus NL63, providing insight into the potential for concurrent viral infections in clinical settings.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This case underscores the importance of considering coinfections in patients presenting with symptoms consistent with chikungunya virus, particularly during monsoon seasons when multiple viral infections are common.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be representative of broader trends, and the evidence is based on clinical observations rather than comprehensive epidemiological data.

analysis.summary_en: This case report documents a rare instance of coinfection with chikungunya virus and coronavirus NL63 in a 37-year-old male patient in Bangladesh during monsoon season. The patient presented with fever, joint pain, rash, loose motion, cough, and runny nose, and RT-PCR confirmed the presence of both viruses. Investigations revealed leucopenia with elevated ESR and CRP, and chest imaging showed a nodule in the left lung. The case highlights the potential for concurrent viral infections in clinical practice, particularly in regions where multiple viruses are prevalent. However, the study's reliance on a single case limits its generalizability and the strength of the evidence. The findings suggest the need for broader surveillance and consideration of coinfections in patients with chikungunya-like symptoms.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨孟加拉国雨季期间基孔肯雅病毒与多种病毒共感染的发生情况,因为在此期间多种病毒感染很常见。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本病例报告描述了一例在孟加拉国出现发热、关节痛、皮疹、腹泻、咳嗽和流鼻涕症状的37岁男性患者,其被发现同时感染基孔肯雅病毒和冠状病毒NL63。
elements_zh.methods: 使用逆转录酶聚合酶链反应(RT-PCR)检测患者样本中的病毒核糖酸(RNA),确认了基孔肯雅病毒和冠状病毒NL63的存在。
elements_zh.main_results: 患者的检查结果显示白细胞减少,血沉(ESR)和C反应蛋白(CRP)升高,胸部影像学检查发现左肺下叶有一个微小结节。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突显了一例罕见的基孔肯雅病毒与冠状病毒NL63共感染病例,为临床环境中并发病毒感染的可能性提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这一病例强调了在出现与基孔肯雅病毒相符症状的患者中考虑共感染的重要性,尤其是在雨季期间多种病毒感染较为常见的情况下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于一例病例报告,可能无法代表更广泛的趋势,且证据基于临床观察而非全面的流行病学数据。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨孟加拉国雨季期间基孔肯雅病毒与多种病毒共感染的发生情况,因为在此期间多种病毒感染很常见。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本病例报告描述了一例在孟加拉国出现发热、关节痛、皮疹、腹泻、咳嗽和流鼻涕症状的37岁男性患者,其被发现同时感染基孔肯雅病毒和冠状病毒NL63。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用逆转录酶聚合酶链反应(RT-PCR)检测患者样本中的病毒核糖酸(RNA),确认了基孔肯雅病毒和冠状病毒NL63的存在。
analysis_zh.main_results: 患者的检查结果显示白细胞减少,血沉(ESR)和C反应蛋白(CRP)升高,胸部影像学检查发现左肺下叶有一个微小结节。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突显了一例罕见的基孔肯雅病毒与冠状病毒NL63共感染病例,为临床环境中并发病毒感染的可能性提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这一病例强调了在出现与基孔肯雅病毒相符症状的患者中考虑共感染的重要性,尤其是在雨季期间多种病毒感染较为常见的情况下。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于一例病例报告,可能无法代表更广泛的趋势,且证据基于临床观察而非全面的流行病学数据。

papers.title: Preliminary efficacy of shallakyadi capsules (Ayurvedic intervention) on post-chikungunya chronic inflammatory rheumatism: Single-arm, open-label clinical trial
papers.abstract: Over 40 % of chikungunya (CHIK) patients develop arthritic manifestations resembling amavata disease as described in Ayurveda. Therefore, a clinical trial was planned to establish the efficacy and safety of the Ayurvedic medicine shallakyadi capsules on post-chikungunya chronic inflammatory rheumatism (pCHIK-CIR). A single-centre, open-label, single-arm, clinical trial was conducted on the participants with pCHIK-CIR. A total of 90 participants were treated with shallakyadi capsule, in a dose of two capsules twice daily (each of 500 mg), orally before lunch and dinner for two months. The primary outcomes were disease activity score (DAS-28) and clinical disease activity index (CDAI), while secondary outcomes were health assessment questionnaire (HAQ) and changes in clinical symptoms. Mean changes were calculated using paired t-tests (for continuous data) and the Wilcoxon signed-rank test (ordinal data). A significant improvement was observed in the changes between before and after treatment for the primary and secondary outcomes, viz. DAS-28 (mean difference (MD) ± standard deviation (SD): 1.27 ± 0.74, p

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the recent surge of dengue and chikungunya in Bangladesh, highlighting the public health problem posed by these diseases and the need for understanding their epidemiological trends.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in Bangladesh between 2023 and 2025, focusing on human populations affected by chikungunya and dengue, with an emphasis on the epidemiological patterns observed during this period.
analysis.methods: The study utilized surveillance data and clinical reports to analyze the trends and patterns of chikungunya and dengue outbreaks in Bangladesh, without detailed laboratory or statistical procedures.
analysis.main_results: The study reported a significant increase in chikungunya cases compared to previous years, with a notable rise in the number of infections and associated symptoms.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the surge as indicative of changing epidemiological dynamics, possibly linked to environmental and behavioral factors, and noted the novelty of the increased prevalence in the region.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted surveillance and public health interventions to manage the rising burden of chikungunya in Bangladesh.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on reported data without detailed laboratory confirmation, and the evidence is moderate due to potential underreporting and lack of comprehensive analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the recent surge of dengue and chikungunya in Bangladesh, emphasizing the public health problem and the need for understanding their epidemiological trends. Conducted between 2023 and 2025, it focuses on human populations affected by these diseases, analyzing the observed increase in infections and symptoms. The authors interpret the surge as indicative of changing dynamics, possibly influenced by environmental and behavioral factors, and highlight the novelty of the increased prevalence in the region. The findings suggest the need for targeted surveillance and interventions to address the rising burden of chikungunya. However, the study is limited by its reliance on reported data without detailed laboratory confirmation, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查孟加拉国近期登革热和基孔肯雅热病例激增的情况,突出这些疾病对公共卫生构成的问题以及理解其流行病学趋势的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究于2023年至2025年在孟加拉国进行,重点关注受基孔肯雅热和登革热影响的人群,特别强调了这一时期观察到的流行病学模式。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用监测数据和临床报告来分析孟加拉国基孔肯雅热和登革热暴发的流行趋势和模式,未涉及详细的实验室或统计方法。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究报告称,与往年相比,基孔肯雅热病例显著增加,感染人数和相关症状均有明显上升。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将病例激增解释为流行病学动态变化的迹象,可能与环境和行为因素有关,并指出该地区病例增加的患病率具有新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为有针对性的监测和公共卫生干预措施提供依据,以应对孟加拉国基孔肯雅热病例上升带来的负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于仅依赖报告数据而没有详细的实验室确认,且由于可能存在漏报和缺乏全面分析,证据强度中等。

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在分析2026年上半年多鲁阿多斯市基孔肯雅热的应对和控制策略。研究动机源于对疾病影响以及该地区公共卫生措施有效性的理解需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在2026年上半年多鲁阿多斯市开展,聚焦于基孔肯雅热的流行病学特征以及市卫生管理部门采取的措施。研究包括对公共卫生策略及其实施情况的回顾,特别是在疾病传播背景下的情况。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究涉及对基孔肯雅热流行病学特征的描述性分析,包括多鲁阿多斯市卫生管理部门实施的主要应对、预防和控制措施的描述。同时,还包括对公共卫生措施挑战和潜在改进的讨论。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究识别并评估了多鲁阿多斯市卫生管理部门在2026年上半年实施的主要应对、预防和控制措施。描述了多鲁阿多斯市基孔肯雅热的流行病学特征,并讨论了当前情境下所面临的挑战。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为强调需要改进基孔肯雅热的应对策略,突出公共卫生措施在控制疾病中的重要性。本研究的新颖之处在于其聚焦于多鲁阿多斯市的具体背景。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为类似流行病学背景下的基孔肯雅热公共卫生政策和策略提供信息。它们提供了关于疾病管理挑战和潜在改进的见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于对公共卫生措施的描述性分析,未包含定量数据或统计分析。证据强度中等,因为它依赖于对实施策略及其效果的定性评估。

papers.abstract: La présente fiche d’information résume les principales connaissances sur le chikungunya, maladie causée par le virus du chikungunya, afin d’aider à comprendre son épidémiologie et son expansion géographique, pour ultimement orienter les interventions en santé publique. Ce document s’adresse aux professionnelles et professionnels de santé publique en maladies infectieuses.

papers.title: Emerging evidence of sand fly fever virus transmission in Sri Lanka.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Sand fly fever virus (SFFV) infection is an acute self-limiting febrile illness caused by phleboviruses and transmitted by sand flies of the Phlebotomus species. The disease has been reported in the Mediterranean region, North Africa, the Middle East, and the Indian subcontinent, and is now considered to be expanding into new geographic areas. Clinically, SFFV infection closely resembles acute dengue fever. AIM: To detect other possible infection including SSFV in patients with clinically suspected dengue fever with negative serology results for NS1 antigen. METHODS: In this study, a total of 757 serum samples were collected from patients clinically suspected of dengue fever and admitted to three major hospitals in Sri Lanka between January and August 2023. Patients were from the Colombo and Kandy District, and demographic information was obtained from laboratory request forms, although detailed individual-level demographic data were limited due to anonymization in this laboratory-based study. All samples were initially screened for dengue NS1 antigen negativity and further tested for a panel of pathogens including SFFV immunoglobulin (Ig) M, hantavirus IgM, chikungunya IgM, and leptospira IgM antibodies, as well as molecular detection of hantavirus, flavivirus, and alphavirus RNA. RESULTS: From tested samples, two samples were serologically positive for SFFV-specific IgM using a commercial immunoblot assay, while all other tests for dengue, chikungunya, leptospira, hantavirus, and related RNA viruses were negative. These two SFFV-positive cases were from Kandy District and included one child (6-8 years) and one adult (40-50 years), both presenting with uncomplicated dengue-like illness. CONCLUSION: This study provides the first evidence of SFFV infection in Sri Lanka. Given the high endemicity of dengue in the country, SFFV infections may be clinically misdiagnosed as dengue and therefore remain under-recognized. Further studies involving febrile patients and sand fly vector surveillance are required to determine the true burden and epidemiological significance of SFFV in Sri Lanka.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在检测在临床疑似登革热但NS1抗原检测为阴性的患者中是否存在其他可能的感染,包括SFFV。SFFV感染是由沙蝇属(Phlebotomus)传播的一种急性自限性发热性疾病,由phleboviruses引起。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 从2023年1月至8月期间,收集了757份来自斯里兰卡三家主要医院的临床疑似登革热患者血清样本。患者来自科伦坡和坎地地区,人口信息来源于实验室申请表,但由于本研究为基于实验室的数据,详细个体层面的人口统计数据受到匿名化限制。
elements_zh.methods: 所有样本首先检测登革热NS1抗原阴性,随后对包括SFFV特异性IgM、汉坦病毒IgM、基孔肯雅病毒IgM和钩端螺旋体IgM抗体在内的多种病原体进行检测,同时进行汉坦病毒、黄病毒和甲病毒RNA的分子检测。
elements_zh.main_results: 在检测的样本中,有2份样本通过商业免疫印迹检测显示SFFV特异性IgM阳性,而登革热、基孔肯雅热、钩端螺旋体、汉坦病毒及相关RNA病毒的其他检测均为阴性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究首次提供了斯里兰卡SFFV感染的证据。鉴于该国登革热的高流行性,SFFV感染可能被误诊为登革热,从而未被充分认识。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,由于SFFV与登革热的临床相似性,SFFV感染可能在斯里兰卡被低估。这凸显了需要进一步研究包括发热患者和沙蝇媒介 监测,以确定SFFV在该地区的实际负担和流行病学意义。

papers.title_zh: 斯里兰卡出现沙蝇热病毒传播感染的新证据。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Sand fly fever virus (SFFV) infection is an acute self-limiting febrile illness caused by phleboviruses and transmitted by sand flies of the Phlebotomus species. The disease has been reported in the Mediterranean region, North Africa, the Middle East, and the Indian subcontinent, and is now considered to be expanding into new geographic areas. Clinically, SFFV infection closely resembles acute dengue fever. AIM: To detect other possible infection including SSFV in patients with clinically suspected dengue fever with negative serology results for NS1 antigen. METHODS: In this study, a total of 757 serum samples were collected from patients clinically suspected of dengue fever and admitted to three major hospitals in Sri Lanka between January and August 2023. Patients were from the Colombo and Kandy District, and demographic information was obtained from laboratory request forms, although detailed individual-level demographic data were limited due to anonymization in this laboratory-based study. All samples were initially screened for dengue NS1 antigen negativity and further tested for a panel of pathogens including SFFV immunoglobulin (Ig) M, hantavirus IgM, chikungunya IgM, and leptospira IgM antibodies, as well as molecular detection of hantavirus, flavivirus, and alphavirus RNA. RESULTS: From tested samples, two samples were serologically positive for SFFV-specific IgM using a commercial immunoblot assay, while all other tests for dengue, chikungunya, leptospira, hantavirus, and related RNA viruses were negative. These two SFFV-positive cases were from Kandy District and included one child (6-8 years) and one adult (40-50 years), both presenting with uncomplicated dengue-like illness. CONCLUSION: This study provides the first evidence of SFFV infection in Sri Lanka. Given the high endemicity of dengue in the country, SFFV infections may be clinically misdiagnosed as dengue and therefore remain under-recognized. Further studies involving febrile patients and sand fly vector surveillance are required to determine the true burden and epidemiological significance of SFFV in Sri Lanka.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:沙蝇热病毒(SFFV)感染是由沙蝇属(Phlebotomus)传播的一种急性自限性发热性疾病,由phleboviruses引起。该疾病已在地中海地区、北非、中东和南亚次大陆被报道,现在被认为正在向新的地理区域扩散。临床表现上,SFFV感染与急性登革热非常相似。目的:检测在临床疑似登革热但NS1抗原检测为阴性的患者中是否存在其他可能的感染,包括SFFV。方法:本研究从2023年1月至8月期间,收集了757份来自斯里兰卡三家主要医院的临床疑似登革热患者血清样本。患者来自科伦坡和坎地地区,人口信息来源于实验室申请表,但由于本研究为基于实验室的数据,详细个体层面的人口统计数据受到匿名化限制。所有样本首先检测登革热NS1抗原阴性,随后对包括SFFV特异性IgM、汉坦病毒IgM、基孔肯雅病毒IgM和钩端螺旋体IgM抗体在内的多种病原体进行检测,同时进行汉坦病毒、黄病毒和甲病毒RNA的分子检测。结果:在检测的样本中,有2份样本通过商业免疫印迹检测显示SFFV特异性IgM阳性,而登革热、基孔肯雅热、钩端螺旋体、汉坦病毒及相关RNA病毒的其他检测均为阴性。这2例SFFV阳性病例来自坎地地区,包括一名6-8岁儿童和一名40-50岁成人,均表现为非复杂性登革热样疾病。结论:本研究首次提供了斯里兰卡SFFV感染的证据。鉴于该国登革热的高流行性,SFFV感染可能被误诊为登革热,从而未被充分认识。需要进一步研究包括发热患者和沙蝇媒介 监测,以确定SFFV在斯里兰卡的真实负担和流行病学意义。

papers.title: Near pan-alphavirus neutralization by an antibody-nanobody bispecific
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Alphaviruses represent a global concern, with some such as chikungunya virus currently infecting thousands in China and others such as Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus inducing neurological symptoms in 4–14% of infected individuals. A single antibody capable of protecting from all human-infecting alphaviruses, by achieving sufficient potency against each virus individually, may have high utility, as only a single therapeutic would then need to be stockpiled against this entire class of emerging pathogens. We previously identified an antibody, SKT05, with broad encephalitic alphavirus recognition, and we also identified nanobodies capable of neutralizing both arthritogenic and encephalitic alphaviruses. Here, we employ structure-based design to engineer a SKT05-nanobody bispecific, which has near pan-neutralization of alphaviruses that infect humans. Twenty-three designed SKT05-nanobody bispecifics broadly neutralized pseudotyped viruses expressing envelope proteins of encephalitic alphaviruses. With 10 of these bispecifics, we further assessed live arthritogenic alphavirus neutralization for Mayaro, O’nyong’nyong, Ross River, and Una viruses, observing potent neutralization for all of them with four bispecifics. The best of these four, V2C3-30-SKT05H, comprising the V2C3 nanobody genetically fused through a 30-amino acid linker to the heavy chain of SKT05, potently neutralized 9 of 11 tested alphaviruses that were phylogenetically proximal to all 26 alphaviruses that infect and cause symptoms in humans. Further, therapeutic administration of V2C3-30-SKT05H reduced viral loads in chikungunya virus-infected mice. Electron microscopy revealed that V2C3-30-SKT05H induced disorder of E1E2 spikes on the viral surface, suggesting E1E2 disassembly as a potential neutralization mechanism. Collectively, these results demonstrate near pan-neutralization of human-infecting alphaviruses by an antibody-nanobody bispecific.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed structure-based design to engineer a SKT05-nanobody bispecific, testing its neutralization capabilities against various alphaviruses.
analysis.methods: The researchers used previously identified SKT05 and nanobodies to create a bispecific antibody, which was tested for its ability to neutralize pseudotyped and live alphaviruses.
analysis.main_results: Twenty-three designed SKT05-nanobody bispecifics broadly neutralized pseudotyped viruses expressing envelope proteins of encephalitic alphaviruses. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated near pan-neutralization of human-infecting alphaviruses by an antibody-nanobody bispecific, highlighting the potential of this approach for therapeutic use.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest a promising therapeutic strategy for the prevention and treatment of alphavirus infections, including chikungunya virus, by providing broad protection against multiple alphaviruses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of pseudotyped viruses and the need for further testing in vivo, but the evidence is strong for the near pan-neutralization capability of the bispecific antibody.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 α病毒是一类全球性关注的病原体,其中一些如基孔肯雅病毒正在中国感染数千人,而另一些如委内瑞拉马脑炎病毒则在感染个体中引发神经症状的比例为4–14%。一种能够对所有人类感染的α病毒提供足够中和效力的单克隆抗体,可能具有很高的应用价值,因为这样只需储备一种治疗药物即可应对整个类别的新兴病原体。我们之前鉴定出了一种具有广泛脑炎α病毒识别能力的抗体SKT05,并且还鉴定出能够中和关节炎型和脑炎型α病毒的纳米抗体。在此研究中,我们采用基于结构的设计方法,工程化了一种SKT05-纳米抗体双特异性抗体,该抗体对感染人类的α病毒具有近全谱中和能力。设计的23种SKT05-纳米抗体双特异性抗体广泛中和了表达脑炎型α病毒包膜蛋白的假病毒。使用其中10种双特异性抗体,我们进一步评估了对活体关节炎型α病毒的中和能力,包括马脑炎病毒、基孔肯雅病毒、罗斯河病毒和Una病毒,观察到四种双特异性抗体对所有这些病毒均表现出强效中和作用。这四种中和效果最好的双特异性抗体之一V2C3-30-SKT05H,由V2C3纳米抗体通过30个氨基酸连接子与SKT05重链进行基因融合,对11种在系统发育上接近所有26种感染并导致人类症状的α病毒中,有9种表现出强效中和作用。此外,V2C3-30-SKT05H的治疗性给药可降低基孔肯雅病毒感染小鼠的病毒载量。电子显微镜显示,V2C3-30-SKT05H可诱导病毒表面E1E2刺突的紊乱,提示E1E2解聚可能是其中和机制。综上所述,这些结果表明一种抗体-纳米抗体双特异性抗体可对人类感染的α病毒实现近全谱中和。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在应对α病毒的全球性关注,特别是基孔肯雅病毒,该病毒正在中国感染数千人,并在感染个体中引发神经症状的比例显著。研究目标是鉴定一种能够对所有人类感染的α病毒提供保护的单克隆抗体,以增强治疗的实用性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用基于结构的设计方法,工程化了一种SKT05-纳米抗体双特异性抗体,并测试其对多种α病毒的中和能力。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员利用之前鉴定的SKT05和纳米抗体,创建了一种双特异性抗体,并测试其对假病毒和活体α病毒的中和能力。
analysis_zh.main_results: 设计的23种SKT05-纳米抗体双特异性抗体广泛中和了表达脑炎型α病毒包膜蛋白的假病毒。此外,四种双特异性抗体对活体关节炎型α病毒表现出强效中和作用,其中一种V2C3-30-SKT05H对11种在系统发育上接近所有26种感染并导致人类症状的α病毒中,有9种表现出强效中和作用。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究展示了抗体-纳米抗体双特异性抗体对人类感染的α病毒具有近全谱中和能力,突显了这种方法在治疗应用中的潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,通过提供对多种α病毒的广泛保护,这种双特异性抗体可能为预防和治疗α病毒感染,包括基孔肯雅病毒,提供一种有前景的治疗策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用假病毒以及需要进一步的体内测试,但双特异性抗体的近全谱中和能力的证据是强有力的。

papers.title: Harnessing Coordinated CD4+ and CD8+ T-Cell Immunity for Virus-Specific Adoptive Immunotherapy in Africa
papers.abstract: Virus-specific T-cell (VST) therapy has developed principally for persistent or reactivating viral infections in immunocompromised patients, with the strongest clinical experience involving cytomegalovirus, Epstein–Barr virus, human adenovirus, BK polyomavirus and human herpesvirus 6. Whether this approach can be extended to emerging and re-emerging viral infections remains less certain. Evidence that virus-specific CD4+ and CD8+ T cells contribute to natural or vaccine-induced protection provides a biological basis for therapeutic development but does not establish the efficacy of adoptively transferred VSTs. This distinction is particularly important for viruses of relevance to Africa, including Ebola virus, Lassa virus, Marburg virus, dengue virus, chikungunya virus, Rift Valley fever virus and mpox virus. Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) provides clinical proof-of-concept that rapidly developed, partially HLA-matched or banked virus-reactive T-cell products can be administered against a newly emerging pathogen. Experimental adoptive transfer studies provide additional evidence for selected pathogens, including Ebola virus, whereas other emerging viruses remain supported mainly by human immunological, epitope or preclinical data. Translation to African populations will require definition of protective viral targets, population-relevant HLA restrictions, viral sequence conservation, manufacturing feasibility and clinical indications in which cellular therapy offers a clear advantage. This review examines the evidence required to move from antiviral T-cell immunity to therapeutic VST development and proposes a framework for evaluating emerging and re-emerging viral infections as future VST targets in Africa.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), chikungunya disease, and recognized CHIKV lineages. The central question is whether virus-specific T-cell (VST) therapy can be applied to emerging and re-emerging viral infections, particularly in the African context, and what evidence is required to move from antiviral T-cell immunity to therapeutic VST development.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of the evidence required to evaluate emerging and re-emerging viral infections as future VST targets in Africa. It examines the biological basis for therapeutic development, including evidence that virus-specific CD4+ and CD8+ T cells contribute to natural or vaccine-induced protection. The review also highlights the need for population-relevant HLA restrictions, viral sequence conservation, and clinical indications where cellular therapy offers a clear advantage.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: There is consensus that evidence of virus-specific CD4+ and CD8+ T cells contributing to natural or vaccine-induced protection provides a biological basis for therapeutic development. However, this does not establish the efficacy of adoptively transferred VSTs. The review emphasizes the importance of defining protective viral targets, population-relevant HLA restrictions, and viral sequence conservation for successful translation to African populations.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while experimental adoptive transfer studies provide additional evidence for selected pathogens like Ebola virus, other emerging viruses, including Chikungunya virus, remain supported mainly by human immunological, epitope, or preclinical data. There is a lack of clear evidence on the efficacy of adoptively transferred VSTs for Chikungunya virus, and the distinction between natural immunity and therapeutic efficacy remains unresolved.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review proposes a framework for evaluating emerging and re-emerging viral infections as future VST targets in Africa. Additionally, it suggests the importance of developing targeted strategies for Chikungunya virus and other relevant pathogens.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of virus-specific T-cell (VST) therapy for Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in Africa. It outlines the biological basis for VST development, emphasizing the role of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells in natural or vaccine-induced protection. However, it notes that the efficacy of adoptively transferred VSTs remains unproven. The review highlights the need for defining protective viral targets, population-relevant HLA restrictions, and viral sequence conservation to guide therapeutic development. It also identifies gaps in evidence for CHIKV and proposes a framework for evaluating future VST targets in the region.

papers.abstract_zh: 病毒特异性T细胞(VST)疗法主要针对免疫功能低下患者的持续性或复发性病毒感染,其中在巨细胞病毒、EB病毒、人类腺病毒、BK多瘤病毒和人类疱疹病毒6的治疗中积累了最丰富的临床经验。然而,这种方法是否可以扩展到新兴和再兴的病毒性疾病仍存在不确定性。已有证据表明,病毒特异性CD4+和CD8+ T细胞在自然或疫苗诱导的保护中起作用,这为治疗性开发提供了生物学基础,但并未确立过继转移VST的有效性。这种区别对于非洲相关病毒尤为重要,包括埃博拉病毒、拉沙病毒、马尔堡病毒、登革热病毒、基孔肯雅病毒、裂谷热病毒和猴痘病毒。严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(SARS-CoV-2)提供了临床概念验证,表明可以快速开发、部分HLA匹配或库存的病毒反应性T细胞产品可用于新出现的病原体。实验性过继转移研究为某些病原体(如埃博拉病毒)提供了额外的证据,而其他新兴病毒则主要依赖于人类免疫学、表位或临床前数据的支持。将该疗法应用于非洲人群需要明确保护性病毒靶标、与当地人群相关的HLA限制、病毒序列的保守性、制造可行性以及细胞治疗具有明显优势的临床指征。本综述探讨了从抗病毒药物 T细胞免疫到治疗性VST开发所需的证据,并提出了一个框架,用于评估新兴和再兴的病毒性疾病作为未来VST靶标在非洲的潜力。

papers.title: A multiplex serological assay for quantification of arbovirus antibody kinetics and neutralizing antibodies
papers.abstract: Arboviruses such as dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) pose major global health threats. To support serological surveillance and study cross-reactivity, an in-house multiplex bead-based immunoassay was developed to measure IgG responses against a wide panel of orthoflavivirus and alphavirus antigens. Samples from Senegal, France, the Philippines, and Bangladesh enabled analyses to be carried out in endemic and non-endemic regions. IgG kinetics following DENV1 and CHIKV infections revealed virus-specific temporal profiles and identified antigens, such as CHIKV E2 and VLP, as well as DENV1 EDIII and SNAP-tagged EDIII, as promising markers for serosurveillance. A two-step Random Forest model was used to classify PRNT-positive samples and predict PRNT titers. CHIKV showed a strong correlation between IgG and PRNT titers (R2 = 0.71), while DENV1 showed weaker performance (R2 = 0.42). These results support the use of multiplex serology for arbovirus surveillance and highlight the limitations of using binding antibodies to predict neutralisation, particularly for orthoflaviviruses.

CHIKV showed a strong correlation between IgG and PRNT titers (R2 = 0.71), while DENV1 showed weaker performance (R2 = 0.42). These results support the use of multiplex serology for arbovirus surveillance and highlight the limitations of using binding antibodies to predict neutralisation, particularly for orthoflaviviruses.
